deploy-bot: Deploy command queued: v3.4.1 -> regions [us, eu, apac]. Canary: us-1 (10% traffic). Change window: 09:30-11:00 UTC. Capacity guards: autoscale min=2, max=20. Starting now.

maya: Picking this up. I'll run the capacity sweep on us-canary pools and verify GPU pod saturation.

linus: Heads-up: apac dedicated pools at ~85% baseline during business hours. Recommend pin apac to v3.3.9 until we confirm capacity.

maya: Agreed. Plan: 1) start US canary 10% for 15m and monitor p99/errors & queue length. 2) if healthy, promote EU to 30% for 30m. 3) keep APAC pinned to previous model behind flag.

sre-oncall: I'll watch infra metrics (GPU util, free mem, scheduler queue). Alert thresholds: GPU util > 92% or queue > 120s -> immediate rollback. I'll have PagerDuty ready.

kevin: Quick sanity check commands:
```bash
# check pool utilization
redwood infra pool-stats --region us --pool canary
```

olga: If US canary passes, we can bump EU more aggressively, but keep APAC pinned behind feature flag `apac_pin_v3_3_9`.

jordan: Noted. I'll prepare release notes snippet and create rollout record with the APAC pin reason.

deploy-bot: CANARY STARTED: us at 10% traffic. instance_ids [g3-us-canary-04]. live_ts 1769932100.

maya: US p99 = 112ms, errors +5 in last 5m (small spike in reranker path). Investigating reranker model chain.

linus: If reranker spike persists, fallback policy: route rerank to CPU-fallback model `rerank-v2-cpu` using routing policy `rerank-fallback`. That avoids rolling back the whole release.

sre-oncall: GPU util steady 72%. scheduler queue 3ms. No infra action required.

maya: After 15m, metrics look stable. Recommend proceed to EU canary at 30%.

deploy-bot: EU CANARY STARTED: eu at 30% traffic. instance_ids [g3-eu-canary-02, g3-eu-canary-03]. live_ts 1769932225.

kevin: Monitoring EU now; baseline EU Dedicated at 65%. No red flags.

olga: APAC remains pinned to v3.3.9 per capacity gating. I'll schedule APAC capacity validation in the next ops window (maintenance Wed 03:00 UTC).

jordan: Release notes draft: "v3.4.1 staged rollout. APAC temporarily pinned to v3.3.9 due to capacity gating. See internal rollout record #1769932100." Will post to channel once final.

maya: Everything green from my side. No rollback required.

linus: Thanks team. Closing thread; leaving APAC pin in place until ops window next week. :white_check_mark:
